housing.summary: No verified Numbeo city-level rent data was found for Gävle (the city is too small for Numbeo's database). Based on Swedish regional averages and proximity to Stockholm, 1-bedroom city-centre rents are estimated in the 6,500–8,500 SEK/month range, but no direct verified figure could be confirmed from fetched sources. Main rental portals are blocket.se (now qasa.se) and hemnet.se.

banking.summary: Major Swedish banks operating in Gävle include Swedbank, Handelsbanken, SEB, and Nordea. To open an account newcomers typically need: valid passport or national ID, Swedish personnummer or samordningsnummer, proof of address, and in some cases proof of employment or income.
required_docs: Proof of employment or income (some banks)

schools.summary: Gävle is in Gävleborg County. International school options within Gävle are limited; the Swedish national school directory (Skolverket) lists available schools. Families seeking IB or other international curricula may need to consider the broader region or distance education. No directly verified international school was found in Gävle from fetched sources.

legal_admin.summary: All persons moving to Sweden must register with Skatteverket via Folkbokföring (population registration) within 3 months. In Gävle, this is done at a local Skatteverket service office. Registration is required to receive a personnummer and access public services.

tax_finance.summary: Personnummer is assigned by Skatteverket upon Folkbokföring. It is a 10-digit personal identity number essential for banking, healthcare, employment, and tax matters in Sweden.

transport.summary: Public transport in Gävle is operated by X-trafik (the regional transit authority for Region Gävleborg, website: xtrafik.se). X-trafik operates buses and X-tåg trains. Exact 30-day pass price was not retrieved from the pricing page (404 errors); Numbeo data for Gävle was unavailable. A half-price campaign on 30-day passes was running Jul–Dec 2026. EU/EEA driving licences valid indefinitely in Sweden; non-EU licences valid 1 year after residency then must be exchanged. Healthcare via Region Gävleborg vårdcentral.
transport.driving_licence_exchange: EU/EEA licences remain valid in Sweden indefinitely. Non-EU licences valid for 1 year from registration; thereafter exchange required via Transportstyrelsen.
transport.healthcare_registration: Register with a Region Gävleborg vårdcentral (primary care centre) at 1177.se
